name: Red Cliffs
description: Site where Kongming and Zhou Yu planned a fire attack on Wei.

timeline.summary: At Red Cliffs Kongming and Zhou Yu both write 'Fire' on their palms.
timeline.quote: They laughed as they both revealed the same word, "Fire."

citation.text: Brilliant Plan (Portal Three Kingdoms, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Cao Cao escapes Red Cliffs with only 27 of his 800,000 men.
timeline.quote: Cao Cao escaped from the battle of Red Cliffs with only 27 of his original 800,000 men.

citation.text: Exhaustion (Portal Three Kingdoms, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
